D2_counterfactuals.misfit: Main estimates used natural corpus notes (no counterfactuals); the only constructed texts were 8 hand-written 2x2 paragraphs.

pq_calls.what: hand-written pottery/chess matched paragraphs x with/without inserted 'What more could she want?' (topic x rhetq 2x2)
hand-written knitting/astronomy matched paragraphs x with/without inserted 'She keeps Sunday clear for it.' (topic x weekday 2x2)

decisive_readings.what: Topic x weekday 2x2 on true logits: weekday effect 8.375 vs topic 12.76, ratio 0.66 above 0.3 main-cue cutoff (corpus regression had given 0.89).
Full-384 corpus regression ratios: signoff -0.14 (was -0.28 at n256), all non-weekday properties at most 0.14, below cutoff.
Corpus-regression dependence ratios for all 7 properties at most ~0.12 at corpus sizes 384/256/192; no true-logit test spent.
Corpus-regression casing ratio 2.1-2.6 across corpus sizes, other properties at most 0.12; no true-logit test.
Topic x rhetorical-question 2x2 on true logits: rhetq effect 2.18 vs topic 20.21, ratio 0.108 below 0.15 cutoff; regression had 0.205 borderline.

notes: Regression readings count 384 corpus notes as n_notes (not edit pairs), so replicated is set true. The 2x2s use two base paragraphs, each with one edit, so n_notes=2. An n-gram search at step 51 for a missed property supported the none answers but did not decide them. Topic-cap greedy at step 80 is coded L_TOPK_FILTER, not L_GREEDY.
